[[File:Adaman Armor - Exterior.png|thumb|300px|The exterior of Adaman Armor.]]
'''Adaman Armor''' is a shop located in [[Gilneas City]]. It was run by [[Adaman]], an exceptionally talented blacksmith who used to work with a rare material called [[Dawnstone]]. By the time of the [[Gilnean civil war]], Adaman had passed away, but his [[Dawnstone Plans (object)|plans]] remained in his shop and his old friend [[Therum Deepforge]] asked adventurers to retrieve them so that his findings could be properly recorded in both Stormwind and Ironforge.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|41D|Behind The Wall}}</ref>
